create_PointmapL1Loss_mean: create a PointmapL1Loss instance with mean reduction and default loss weight of 1.0
create_PointmapL1Loss_normalize: create a PointmapL1Loss instance with normalization enabled to normalize predictions and targets by their average vector norm
forward_PointmapL1Loss: compute the L1 loss between predicted and target point maps using a PointmapL1Loss forward pass
forward_PointmapL1Loss_custom_reduction: compute the L1 loss with a custom reduction override such as sum or none
get_loss_name: get the loss name property from a PointmapL1Loss instance to identify the loss function
